disputed_verses.KJV 2CH 29:13: And of the sons of Elizaphan; Shimri, and Jeiel: and of the sons of Asaph; Zechariah, and Mattaniah:

first_reader_said: 2CH 29:13: Both records are Jeiel of the sons of Elizaphan in this verse (B wrongly calls him Gershonite).

why: Both records identify Jeiel alongside Shimri among the sons of Elizaphan in 2CH 29:13, with identical ancestry and verse attribution. A's Gershonite label is erroneous: Elizaphan is descended through Uzziel (EXO 6:22), of the Kohathite line correctly recorded in B. B therefore preserves the fuller, correct identification.
